create_atomicdata_from_ase: create an AtomicData object from an ASE Atoms object with neighbor graph edges using pymatgen
convert_atomicdata_to_ase: convert an AtomicData object back to a list of ASE Atoms objects for visualization or analysis
batch_atomicdata_list: batch a list of single-graph AtomicData objects into a single batched AtomicData object for model inference
reconstruct_examples_from_batch: reconstruct individual AtomicData examples from a batched AtomicData object using get_example or index_select
update_batch_edges: update the edge connectivity of a batched AtomicData object with new edge_index, cell_offsets, and nedges tensors
